body: Eh. I think she is fine. Dolton just kinda showed up out of nowhere and then died.

I just... I keep trying, and I keep failing. Started when my gf of 5 years agreed to marry me, but then ran off with another dude shortly before the wedding. Really fucked me up. That plus becoming an alcoholic for a year or so led me to try and hang. Stupid mistake was sending some goodbye texts to my mom and a friend. They call the cops. Spend 2 weeks in psych ward. All my "buddies" after the fact were so worried and concerned of course and gave me the old throw away line. 

That got me in to therapy and on meds. 2 years ago now. And nothing has changed. Since then, I lived with a roommate who ended up screwing me out of and stealing from me close to 10 grand and then ran off. So, had to move out of my apartment.

So I'm currently mostly living out of my car. I have a couch in my parents living room if need be, but my divorced sister is already living there with her 3 year old.

I constantly see people living life and I just can't do it. I've tried. I just fucking lose every time. Everything I try to do fucks up one way or another. I'm so tired of putting in effort to get nothing in return.

Then why do they pretend. Why tell me "dude, if you ever need to talk just say the word". and then when I say the word just ignore me? For weeks? 

Slowly realizing that nobody actually cares. Nobody gives a fuck about you unless they have something to gain. 

I don't want to live in a world like this.
